1.0.1.en: Added Zigbee Dongle E/P, SNZB-04P, ZBMINI, and SNZB-02LD/WD drivers, plus settings fixes for ZBMINIR2/MINI-ZBD.

1.0.5.en: Availability tracking for mains-powered devices (ZBMINI, ZBMINIR2, MINI-ZB1GP/GSP, SNZB-06P, Zigbee Dongle E/P) and the SNZB-02LD/WD thermometers, with a Traffic and Rejoins overview in the app settings. Last-seen time for the SNZB-03 and SNZB-04P/PR2 sensors. SNZB-04P battery reporting, SNZB-06P fixes, and the new SNZB-05P water leak sensor and SNZB-09P siren.
